text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P67890 fired for service=model-serving-prod region=us-east-az3 severity=high — sudden 5xx spike (>40% above baseline). Link: https://pagerduty.example/P67890

pagerduty: Paging Maya (sre-oncall). Escalation policy: primary -> 2nd.

Maya: Ack — I'm on it. Checking dashboards and recent deploys.

Maya: Quick signal: 5xx rate ~42% for us-east-az3, p95 latency up ~600ms, KV cache evictions spiking. No recent deploys in the last 30m that match this pattern.

Stefan: :rotating_light: Infra telemetry shows NIC error counters climbing on az3 fabric facing topo1. I see increased packet drops and a few transient BGP flaps in the last 6m.

Carlos: Runtime note — we're seeing cache thrashing on model-shard-12 which sits primarily in az3. Cold misses + retry storms -> gRPC connection resets. Likely cascading. Recommend diverting traffic off az3 while we investigate.

Maya: Agreed. Activating routing fallback to us-east-az1 and enabling scaled-up warm pool for affected model shards. Running command:

```
# enable routing fallback for az3 -> az1
redctl route fallback activate --region us-east --from az3 --to az1 --policy capacity-balanced --duration 30m
```

incident-bot: Routing fallback activation requested. Change-ID cfg-5b3c2f. Rolling out to edge/router fleet.

pagerduty: Escalating to Priya (sre-2nd) per policy. New page P67891.

Priya: Ack. Standing by. Maya, can you run a smoke test once fallback is live?

Maya: Running smoke now.

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ***" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","model":"serving-prod"}' -w "\nhttp_code:%{http_code}\n"
# result: http_code:200
# response: {"id":"r123","status":"ok"}
```

Carlos: Metrics update — error rate in us-east dropped from 42% -> 1.8% within 2m after fallback. Latency p95 returned to normal. Warm pool scale-up started.

Lila: Support: we've received a ticket from AcmeCorp reporting ~20% of requests returned 503 between 14:02-14:10 UTC. Ticket #SUP-987. Also one inbound from BetaApps. Posting to status page now.

Maya: Creating incident page and runbook pointer: https://incidents.redwood/6543219876 — tagging network and routing teams.

Stefan: I'll file a fabric/network investigation—NIC counters, TOM log bundle attached to ticket NET-4321. Early hypothesis: intermittent NIC firmware bug + increased traffic leading to queue drops.

Priya: I'll draft targeted customer comms for AcmeCorp, BetaApps, GammaLabs. We should be transparent: mitigation in progress, rerouted traffic, ETA for deeper RCA within 48 hours.

incident-bot: Auto-silencing further PagerDuty alerts for service=model-serving-prod for 15m while mitigation is active.

Carlos: KVCACHE warm-up jobs enqueued to reduce cold-start rate. Command snippet: 

```
for key in $(cat hot_keys.txt); do redctl cache prefetch --shard $shard --key $key &
done
```

Maya: Partial mitigation in place. Leaving fallback on for 30m, monitoring metrics and support queue. If error resurges, plan B: force warm-up + emergency scale of dedicated model pool and keep fallback until fabric team confirms fix.

Lila: Status page update posted: "We are mitigating an issue affecting some customers in us-east. Traffic is being routed to healthy zones; some requests previously returned errors. We will provide updates as we validate stability."

Priya: I'll stay on watch for the next 40m and join if anything changes.

Stefan: Network ticket created and assigned to net-team; attaching packet captures and NIC logs.

incident-bot: PagerDuty P67890 status changed to acknowledged; mitigation in progress. Automated note: duration 18m so far.

Maya: Handing over monitoring to Priya. I'll update the incident doc with timeline and action items. Leaving oncall channel. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Took over monitoring. Keeping PD on for visibility until 30m expiration.

incident-bot: Final note logged to incident: fallback route id cfg-5b3c2f applied at ts=6543219876, initial error spike mitigated.

(End of thread)
